fields.Name: T135 - Communication Monitor
fields.Description: Verifies the Communication app's Monitor section renders the delivery monitoring dashboard with its status widgets or a valid empty-state, without crashing.

InputDefinition.goal: Using the application switcher dropdown next to the logo (NOT the Ctrl+K search box), open the Communication app, then open its Monitor section (the default landing section). Confirm the delivery monitoring dashboard renders, showing status widgets/metrics or a valid empty-state. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment - wait, do not navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: The Communication app is open with the Monitor section selected
The delivery monitoring dashboard renders, showing status widgets/metrics or a valid empty-state
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
